caption:
Havells — one device, many jobs.

An industrial-design concept: a single sleek desk object that becomes whatever you need — a fan, a table lamp, a computer monitor, a music player, a personal assistant — then mounts on the wall, as cool as a skateboard, when you're done. One product replacing a deskful of gadgets, clutter and all.

Industrial / product design — Anirudh Kapoor. A·52.
